subject: Renewal & capacity increase: procurement gate and onboarding refresh
messages:
From: Sara Lopez <procurement@acmehealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal discussions + SOW draft

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and finance have reviewed the rough numbers and would like to start formalizing the renewal and a capacity increase. We currently have a Q3 needs spike projected: +40% token throughput and two additional dedicated instances for fall load testing.

Attached is our SOW template (Acme_PO_template.pdf) and the baseline terms our legal team expects. A few asks up front:
- Can Redwood accommodate an 18-month term (instead of the current 12) with a staged invoice schedule?
- We need SOC2 evidence and a short onboarding checklist to feed our vendor portal.
- Who is the contact for purchase order/PO routing and Net30 invoice processing?

If you can loop in the right folks on your side (legal/finance/ops) we can populate our procurement portal and move to PO creation next week.

Best,
Sara Lopez
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health
(attachment: Acme_PO_template.xlsx)
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussions + SOW draft

Sara — thanks for the details and the template. Looping in Vanessa (Customer Success lead) and Karthik (Pricing & Contracts) so we can align on SOW redlines and billing cadence.

Quick answers up front:
- Term: We can do an 18-month term; we typically offer a modest renewal credit for commits >=12 months. Karthik, will share the pricing delta and an example invoice schedule.
- Capacity: +40% throughput and two dedicated instances are feasible; Marcus (ops) will confirm capacity provisioning lead times.
- SOC2 & onboarding: attaching our SOC2 summary and a concise onboarding checklist. I also put a stub of the redlined SOW in that highlights the term and capacity changes.

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik shares redline and proposed invoice schedule by EOD Monday.
2) Vanessa sends the onboarding checklist and a short intake form for your procurement portal (so your system has the right fields).
3) If Acme is comfortable, I’ll upload the (redlined) SOW to our procurement portal and send a DocuSign link for signature.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf (redline), SOC2_Report_2026.pdf, Onboarding_Checklist.md

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal discussions + SOW draft — need pricing & ops ETA

Team — forwarding Acme's procurement note. Highlights: 18-month term, +40% throughput, +2 dedicated instances, they want SOC2 evidence and PO routing.

Karthik — can you run pricing for an 18-month commit with the capacity bump and propose an invoice schedule (monthly vs quarterly vs staged)? Please include how renewal credit would apply.
Marcus — please confirm provisioning lead time for two extra dedicated instances and whether we need any seasonal capacity reservations.
Vanessa — I’ll need the onboarding intake form for their procurement portal so they can import fields.

I plan to upload the redlined SOW to the portal once we have pricing. Acme asked for next-week PO creation; timeline is tight.

—Priyom
(attachment: Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf)
From: Tom Biddle <tbiddle@acmehealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lopez <procurement@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health AR <ar@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal discussions + SOW draft

Priyom — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifications from finance:
- We prefer a staged invoice schedule with an initial 30% deposit on signature, 50% at midterm, 20% on completion of the second quarter of usage. Net30 on each invoice is required.
- PO will be issued once the SOW is final and a DocuSign link is received.
- For the procurement portal, we need a short vendor onboarding file (CSV import) that includes: company legal name, remit-to address, W-9 or equivalent, SOC2 attestation link. Can Redwood provide a single-line vendor record we can import?

If you can confirm the provisioning lead time and a target signature date, we’ll queue the PO creation. Happy to do a 15-minute call later today if that helps.

Thanks,
Tom Biddle
Director, Finance Operations
Acme Health
(attachment: Acme_PO_template.xlsx)
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Tom Biddle <tbiddle@acmehealth.com>, Sara Lopez <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussions + SOW draft

Tom/Sara — thanks, all. Quick confirmations and next steps:

- Invoice schedule: Karthik will send a proposed staged schedule that matches your ask; Net30 on invoices is fine.
- Vendor CSV: attaching a one-line vendor record we maintain for Acme import (legal name, remit-to, tax doc link). I’m also attaching SOC2_Report_2026.pdf and the onboarding checklist for your portal.
- Provisioning lead time: Marcus confirms 7 business days to spin up the two dedicated instances after signature and receipt of initial deposit. If you need guaranteed capacity on a certain date we can reserve slots for an additional one-time ramp fee — Marcus will include in his note.
- Target signature date: would next Thursday (2027-04-29) work? That gives us time to finalize pricing and upload the DocuSign envelope.

Action items: 
1) Karthik: finalize pricing + invoice schedule (EOD today).
2) Marcus: send provisioning & reserve-fee options (EOD today).
3) Vanessa: upload the redlined SOW to the portal and create the DocuSign envelope; share link with Acme.
4) Priyom: I’ll stand up the vendor CSV and confirm remittance details with AR.

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://docusign.com/envelopes/REDWOOD-ACME-7842
Procurement portal record: https://redwood.app/procure/portal/AcmeHealth-7842

Thanks — talk soon.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference
(attachments: Vendor_CSV_row.txt, SOC2_Report_2026.pdf, Onboarding_Checklist.md)
